tree-r1.study: CPU-only prototype; no GPU frame-time or GPU memory claims
tree-r1.method: world-anchored parallel lines sample a piecewise-constant optical grid; each line stores exact ordered (L,T) cell transport in a balanced tree over nonidentity leaves; arbitrary range queries are checked against same-leaf serial composition
tree-r1.composition: (La,Ta) o (Lb,Tb) = (La + Ta*Lb, Ta*Tb); only exactly identity cells are omitted; interpolation, when measured, occurs after each path has been composed
tree-r1.precision: CPU tree path L is three IEEE-754 64-bit doubles and T is one IEEE-754 64-bit double; logical bytes include C struct padding and exclude allocator overhead; current GPU RGB8B/scalar4B precision and memory behavior are not modeled
